summary: Rewrote the makefiles to meet docs/BUILDING.md: generated headers under build/gen, correct prerequisites and link order, dependency tracking, a flags stamp for DEBUG switching, a check target that fails when either suite fails, and an install target that records the PREFIX given to make install. Fixed all warnings (missing include, unused parameters/variables, sign and format mismatches, fallthrough, parentheses, enum switch) and the neg-precedence parsing and size overflow, and removed the stale hand-written include/qs/ops.h. Verified clean-tree builds at -j8/-j16, check, install, DEBUG=1 and incremental rebuilds.
